label: JARVIS
description: Unflappable, impeccably polite, and quietly judging your driving, sir.
direction: Speak in a smooth, composed, refined English voice: a dry, unflappable digital butler, polite on the surface and gently sardonic underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The name is written Jarvis nowhere in the lines, so the clone never has to spell it out. Every line is addressed to sir. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Marvel Studios / The Walt Disney Company
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel and Disney hold copyright and trademark in the character, whose name comes from the Marvel Comics butler Edwin Jarvis. Paul Bettany voiced the role in the films and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Paul Bettany's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer, sir. Do try to stay focused.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Plenty of time, sir.
lines.start_drive_1: Good day, sir. All systems are online.
lines.start_drive_2: At your service, sir. Route calculated.
lines.start_drive_3: Welcome back, sir. Shall we take the car, since the suit is charging?
lines.start_drive_4: I've prepared a route, sir. I trust you will ignore it as usual.
lines.start_drive_5: Importing preferences. Seat belt, sir. I do insist.
lines.start_drive_6: As always, sir, a great pleasure watching you drive.
lines.start_drive_7: For you, sir, always. Starting navigation.
lines.start_drive_8: May I suggest keeping to the speed limit today, sir? No? Very well.
lines.start_drive_9: Engines ready, sir. Do try not to scratch this one.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn, sir. I did try to warn you.
lines.arrived: You have arrived, sir. Welcome home. Well, somewhere.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust me, sir.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I have run the numbers, sir.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead, sir. The suit would have been quicker.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead, sir. For once, not yours.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead, sir. I recommend not flying over it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Might I suggest a little less thrust, sir?
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Do stop, sir. The lawyers insist.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead, sir. Shall I prepare your usual apology?
lines.reroute_chime: A new route, sir. I shall pretend that was intentional.
